summary: Allen's record shows Israel-centric framing: he voted Aye on AB 715, cited coauthoring a Bloom bill opposing BDS, publicly backed deleting "settler colonialism" and right-of-return language from 2019 party resolutions, and affirmed Israel's right to exist and defend itself. His limited humanitarian note—citing SCR 105 for an end to Gaza's catastrophe—was weighed alongside Vote for Peace's Opposed rating and California Jewish Democrats' Strong Support.
